patch_description: The current candidate (single ring + skip-2 + diamond-CRX, doubled) regressed to 0.87, while the earlier modular version with ry/rx layers, ring-CRZ, skip-2, skip-3, and diameter-CRZ entanglement (doubled) achieved the best score so far (0.89) with good test accuracy (0.90) and lower loss. I restore that better-performing modular block structure, and per the recommendation, extend it to three repetitions (all sharing identical parameter names) instead of two. This increases circuit depth/expressivity without adding any new parameters, testing whether additional shared-parameter depth further improves generalization beyond the 2-block version, while keeping the same low parameter count (128) that already showed strong results.
